headline: Stop spending your vacation planning your vacation.
primary_text:
Hours of tabs, reviews and second-guessing. Sound familiar?
Tell me where you want to go and I'll plan and book it for you, at no extra cost to you.
Cruises, resorts, all-inclusives, family trips.
Comment or message me for a free trip quote.

headline: Tell me your dream trip. I'll send back three options this week.
primary_text:
Got a trip in your head you keep putting off?
Tell me where, when and who's coming.
I'll send you three options: the easy one, the upgrade and the bucket list.
Message me "TRAVEL" to start.

headline: "Wait, is this legit?"
primary_text:
If a friend offering travel deals makes you nervous, good. It should.
Here's the honest version: real cruise lines, resorts and airlines, booked through InteleTravel, with me as your person if anything goes sideways.
Ask me anything before you spend a dime.

headline: Love to travel? Learn how travel advisors book trips from home.
primary_text:
Always the one planning the group trip?
I'll walk you through how home-based travel advisors actually work: what it costs, what you do, and whether it fits your life.
15 minutes, over coffee or Zoom. No pressure either way.

headline: Already the friend who plans every trip?
primary_text:
You already research the hotels, find the deals and build the itinerary for everyone.
There's a way to learn that as a side business, with training and a team behind you.
I'll tell you exactly what it costs before anything else.
Message me "CURIOUS" and I'll send you the details.

headline: You don't have to figure it out alone.
primary_text:
Thinking about a travel side business but nervous about doing it wrong?
You'd learn with a team that trains you and answers your questions, not one that pressures you.
Come meet us first. Ask anything, including what it costs.
Message me and I'll save you a seat.
